SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7111
Special Branch S. 5. xxxxxxx
REPORT
Date October 31, 19 35.

Subject Arrest of an hawker in possession of indecent picture albums.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Moore.

Sir,

At 4.45 p.m. October 30 C.D.C. 281, attached to S. 5,
arrested an hawker named Li Ching Lin (李慶林), native of
Shanghai, aged 46, at the corner of Fokien and Foochow Roads
in possession of three small albums, each containing eight
indecent pictures.

The accused was taken to Louza Station and charged
under Article 235 of the Chinese Criminal Code. He was
arraigned before the 1st Special District Court on October 31
when he was sentenced to a fine of $150 or 150 days
imprisonment, and the indecent pictures ordered to be
confiscated.

Accused had seven previous convictions for this
class of offence.

〔此处有手写签名〕
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

〔此处有手写批注：d.c. (crime) / Information / JMc / 31 Oct 1935〕

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 7111
特别处 S. 5. xxxxxxx
报告
日期：1935年10月31日。

事由：逮捕一名持有淫秽画册的小贩。

由 D.S.I. 穆尔（Moore）撰写并呈报。

敬启者，

10月30日下午4时45分，配属于特别处S. 5的华籍侦探警长（C.D.C.）281号，在福建路与福州路转角处，逮捕了一名名为李庆林（Li Ching Lin）的小贩。该犯系上海人，现年46岁，被捕时持有三本小画册，每本内含八张淫秽图片。

被告被带往老闸捕房，并依据《中华民国刑法》第235条被控告。他于10月31日在第一特区法院受审，被判处罚金150元，或监禁150天，其持有的淫秽图片被下令没收。

被告此前曾因同类罪行被定罪七次。

〔此处有手写签名〕
D. S. I.

副督察长（特别处）。
